create_skeleton: create a Skeleton object with parent indices and left/right joint lists for motion capture data
get_num_joints: get the total number of joints in the Skeleton by calling the num_joints method
get_children: get the list of child joints for each joint in the Skeleton using the children method
remove_joints: remove specified joints from the Skeleton and recompute parent and child relationships
get_joints_left_right: get the left and right joint lists from the Skeleton using joints_left and joints_right methods
